_comment: Per-bucket in-scope PASS-COUNT floor for the WPT regression gate (scripts/wpt-scoreboard.php). Gate on counts, not percentages: counts are stable while the corpus total drifts. `tolerance` absorbs rasterisation ±1 jitter. Refresh after intentional gains with: php scripts/wpt-scoreboard.php --update. Numbers are settler-OFF (deterministic, no Playwright dependency) and rendered with the harness DEFAULT FONT (DejaVu Serif) so text-dependent reftests actually exercise text rather than passing blank. Set WPT_DEFAULT_FONT=none to reproduce the legacy font-less numbers.
